notes: Sheet is north-up. Names: PARKER, GRAHAM written with 'Street'; OHIO AV., W. CLIFTON AV., LIDDELL PL. as printed. Two separate streets are printed PRIVATE WAY: the 50' Cincinnati Traction Co. road that leaves Ohio Av near the top, curves west and south past the Clifton car barn and ends at the Bellevue Inclined Plane power house (picked at (5785,1137)); and a short private way leaving the east side of Ohio Av at its bend near (5720,4846) and running ENE off the sheet toward 232. The '?' at Parker (3046,521) is the 50 ft strip lettered 'PROPOSED STREET (NOT OPENED)' with 'STEEP HILL SIDE' running south from Parker to the hillside line (end). The '?' at Clifton (1338,7298) is the unnamed 17 ft street of sheet 230 coming in from the west at Clifton's bend (it lines up with the south side of Clifton's ESE leg). Emming, Conroy and Hastings come in from the sheet-230 margin and end at Clifton (also picked on 230). Parker/Ohio is not picked: its centre is at the very top edge of the page (about (6190,10)); it should be on 242. Graham, Liddell Pl and the short private way are stubs into the 244/232 margins. Bellevue Inclined Plane Railway, car barn and power house ignored.
